title: Port command error normalization and identity preservation
scope: Complete asCommandError over owned typed errors, strings and a fallible host String supplier for other thrown values. Preserve typed-error identity, stale detection/marking and failed-code fallback.
acceptance: Full original registry graph compares typed identity, exact UTF16 envelopes, page state and clock/coercion ordering.
All child predicate/clock/error cases remain required; host limits are separate and typed errors bypass message inspection.
open_items: General native String conversion, actual clocks and complete registry execution remain separate.
Owned message boundaries exclude mutable/reentrant Error.message getters and external prototype mutation.
